book.name: Ola Saam
book.title: Ola Saam Ola Song En Preya Langa God

content.text: Ola pipul langa det kantri Juda sabi God.
Dei rispek im neim langa Isreil.
Im garram kemp langa Jerusalem.
Im jidan langa Saiyan, det bigwan hil.
Deya na, imbin breigimap ola erro blanga ol im enamimob, en ola shild en bigwan naif blanga olabat du.
Ebrijing weya deibin abum blanga fait imbin breigimap.
God, yu shain garram lait brabliwei.
Yu jidan brabli haibalawan wen yu kambek brom detlot bigwan hil weya yubin bidim ol yu enamimob.
Ola breibwan soljamob blanga olabat nomo garram enijing na, en tudei olabat ol dedwan.
Olabat bin strongbala en bin sabi hau blanga fait, bat najing na.
Olabat kaan dum enijing.
God blanga Jeikob, wen yubin graulim olabat adbalawei,
detlot hosis en ola men bin buldanbuldan ded.
Bat oni langa yu YAWEI, ebribodi bradin.
Wen yu gitwail, nobodi kaan jandap langa yu.
Brom ontop langa hebin yubin larram pipul sabi blanga yu kotkeis.
Ola pipul langa dijan wel bin bradin en deibin jidan kwaitbala.
Wen yubin gidap blanga tok langa det kotkeis,
yubin gitredi blanga seibum ola pipul langa dijan wel hu abumbat olkain trabul.
Pipul preisim yu, YAWEI dumaji yu gitwail langa eni nogudbalawei.
Ol detlot hu nomo gitkil langa wofait garra kipgon preisimbat yu.
Gibit langa YAWEI, yu God wanim yubin pramisim im.
Bringimap ola presen langa im, ol yumob pipul hu jidan langa ola gulijapwan kantri.
YAWEI meigim ola pipul bradin en jidan garram rispek langa im brabliwei.
Im meigim ola praudbala bos jidan lobala.
Im meigim ola strongwan king bradin brabliwei.
